digest.component_or_area: rebar metrics command and passive instrumentation
propositions: No durable aggregation layer exists to surface agent-driven dev loop trends over time across event store, sidecars, module-size ratchet, and git

Three tier-C blindspots leave no event-store trace: env/integration-diagnosis intervals, bug provenance (which prior change caused this bug), and bug outcome classification (regression vs plan-defect vs flaky)

A single rebar metrics command must surface every available metric across three lenses (agent loop health, codebase decay, gate value) with date-range filtering and structured unavailable states for metrics with incomplete histories

Blame-derived caused_by edges must be auto-derived best-effort from git blame on the pre-fix state and stamped by trustworthy code, with explicit --caused-by override always winning and skipped derivation when ambiguous
Bug-close friction must remain flat by replacing the required free-text reason with a required bounded --class enum persisted on STATUS events, with no net increase in required arguments

Passive instrumentation closes blindspots via ERROR outcomes on existing gate sidecars (diagnosis intervals), caused_by link relation with blame derivation (provenance), and close_class enum (classification), with all backfilled data labeled source=backfill_classified and never aggregated into authoritative structural series
